def min_operations_to_one_inversion(n, p):
    # Count the number of inversions in the permutation
    inversions = 0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            if p[i] > p[j]:
                inversions += 1
    
    # If there is already exactly one inversion, no operations are needed
    if inversions == 1:
        return 0
    
    # If there are no inversions, we can swap the first two elements
    if inversions == 0:
        return 1
    
    # If there are more than one inversion, we can swap the last two elements
    # to reduce the number of inversions to one
    return n - 2
